panel_sets.notes: One held-out TEST n-way transition per rule family: the first in the scorer's capped order at seed 0, else at the first seed that has one. Columns: s_t with the action, the engine's s_{t+1}, then each arm's generated s_{t+1} (apply_outcome of its own emission) with the engine's judge's mark. Two rows drawn by rule (cmazet_door_search.py): one where the n-CLU is right and >= 4 of the 6 matched baselines are wrong (base n-CLU, seeds 0-2), and one n-CLU door success (key consumed, door then tint) - the base n-CLU has none at seeds 0-2, so it is drawn from the n-CLU-REL run, every column of that row from that run.

Door-then-tint (interaction family): the first seed-0 TEST n-way row per move direction present. Same columns as fig_cmazet_families. N-CLU door-then-tint successes, one per move direction present, drawn by rule (cmazet_door_search.py); the base n-CLU has none at seeds 0-2, so they come from the n-CLU-REL run, every column of those rows from that run.

For every arm, one seed-0 TEST n-way transition on which it is right and one on which it is wrong, each a uniform draw (numpy default_rng(21), arms in manifest order) among the qualifying rows; an arm with no qualifying row gets no row (recorded in selection).

CLU-REL-A10 (the improved CLU config). For every arm, including the six '+rel' diagnostic rivals (rivals given the CLU's relational request columns; not matched baselines), one seed-0 TEST n-way transition on which it is right and one on which it is wrong, each a uniform draw (numpy default_rng(21), arms in manifest order) among the qualifying rows; an arm with no qualifying row gets no row (recorded in selection). Same rows and rule as fig_cmazet_per_arm. The n-CLU-REL 'succeeds' row is a door-then-tint success drawn by rule (cmazet_door_search.py; the seed-0 uniform draw is still consumed so every other row is unchanged).
